package application

import (
 "context"
 "sync/atomic"
 "example.com/cqrs/application/creation/query"
 "github.com/nostosx/servex/cqrs"
)
var ObservedCalls atomic.Int64
var ObservedAssemblies int
var ObservedMetadata cqrs.Metadata
func observeGetOrder(meta cqrs.Metadata,next cqrs.Handler[query.GetOrderQuery,query.GetOrderResult])cqrs.Handler[query.GetOrderQuery,query.GetOrderResult]{
 ObservedAssemblies++
 ObservedMetadata=meta
 return cqrs.QueryFunc[query.GetOrderQuery,query.GetOrderResult](func(ctx context.Context,in query.GetOrderQuery)(query.GetOrderResult,error){ObservedCalls.Add(1);return next.Handle(ctx,in)})
}
